title: Flow reversal signal inherently unstable — DD 10/25 overlay cannot rescue 3200% turnover
lesson: Flow reversal signal produces ~3200% annual turnover regardless of DD overlay parameters. DD 10/25 with min_exp=30% reduced MDD from base ~55% to 48.2% but did not touch turnover because the signal itself (not the overlay) drives portfolio churn. SR 0.214, CAGR 3.26%, OOS retention 0.034. Buffer zone 50/25 insufficient.
root_cause: Flow reversal Z-scores are extremely noisy month-to-month, causing near-complete portfolio turnover at each rebalancing. This is a property of the alpha source, not the overlay.
implication: DD overlay is irrelevant when the underlying signal flips the entire portfolio monthly. Any future flow-reversal strategy must either: (1) use quarterly rebalancing to reduce turnover, (2) apply heavy signal smoothing (e.g., 3-month trailing average), or (3) abandon flow reversal as a standalone signal.
